act1_whisper_ash.name: Ash of the Whisper
act1_whisper_ash.flavour: It was never a body. What burned was the shape it had borrowed.

act1_emissary_seal.name: Shepherd's Broken Seal
act1_emissary_seal.flavour: A fragment of the sigil under Harrow's Reach. Warm, which is the wrong temperature.

act1_thessaly_cane.name: Thessaly's Fractured Cane
act1_thessaly_cane.flavour: Split down the middle by the spell that ended her. Both halves still work.

act1_sentinel_core.name: Sundering Sentinel Core
act1_sentinel_core.flavour: The heart of a construct built to guard a ritual nobody remembers.

act1_choir_sigil.name: Choir Sigil Fragment
act1_choir_sigil.flavour: Bears no crest. It was never meant to be identified.

act1_watchtower_charm.name: Old Watchtower Charm
act1_watchtower_charm.flavour: Carried by someone who expected to need luck and did not.

act2_sanctum_tally.name: Choir Tally Rod
act2_sanctum_tally.flavour: Counts hunters the way a shepherd counts sheep. One mark is fresher than the rest.

act2_mire_pearl.name: Mire Sentinel Pearl
act2_mire_pearl.flavour: Swamp-light in a sphere. It remembers being worshipped, briefly, wrongly.

act2_brine_scale.name: Brine Sentinel Scale
act2_brine_scale.flavour: Cut away to reach the rot beneath. Clean whalebone where the sea wore through.

act2_mine_tally.name: Deepvein Slate
act2_mine_tally.flavour: A miner's tally of every shift survived underground. The last column is unfinished.

act2_enforcer_gauntlet.name: Enforcer's Gauntlet
act2_enforcer_gauntlet.flavour: Grey and silver to match its mistress. It opens, empty, the way a threat does.

act3_canopy_seed.name: Canopy Guardian Seed
act3_canopy_seed.flavour: Given, not taken. It is warm in the palm the way a promise is warm.

act3_ashen_scout.name: Ashen Cloak Clasp
act3_ashen_scout.flavour: Ilsevet's scouts wear no crest either. The clasp is the only part that kept its shape.

act3_warden_plate.name: Mist Warden Pauldron
act3_warden_plate.flavour: Cut from a warden that stood between Ilsevet and the fragment for exactly as long as it could.

act3_vessel_tear.name: Vessel's Shed Tear
act3_vessel_tear.flavour: It wept while it fought. The tear stayed behind when the Hollowing let go.

act4_tide_ash.name: Ash of the Hollow Tide
act4_tide_ash.flavour: What the shockwave left when the line refused to break. It settles, finally, like snow.

act4_anchor_pearl.name: Blood Anchor Pearl
act4_anchor_pearl.flavour: Formed where Veyra's oath met Kaelen's. Two heartbeats, one stone.

act4_crown_cinder.name: Ilsevet's Cinder Crown
act4_crown_cinder.flavour: It was never regalia. It was armour against being overlooked. It fits no one, now.
